description.en: Coil that operates the contacts of a relay. Coil terminals on IEC diagrams are A1 and A2 (see reference document). Note: General coil ID not located; the S00315 found is a coil unaffected by AC (different).
description.es: Bobina que acciona los contactos de un relé. En esquemas IEC los bornes de bobina son A1 y A2 (ver documento de referencia). Nota: ID general de bobina no localizado; el S00315 encontrado es una bobina no afectada por CA (distinta).

note.en: Processes signals (relays; article lists K1, K2 for relays).
note.es: Procesa señales (relés; el artículo lista K1, K2 para relés).

geometry.grid: 1 unit = one symbol grid step; origin top-left, y down; scale to the drawing standard in use

sources.title: Industrial Monitor Direct: IEC 81346-2 contactor and relay numbering (secondary article)
